context_for_next_testing_agent: Trader page now has 4 new features: 1) Monitor system with start/stop/pause using Bollinger Band decision engine, 2) Live candle chart from Bitvavo public API with market selector and interval buttons (1h/4h/1d), 3) Watchlist with 5 coins (BCH/BTC/ETH/SOL/ADA) showing live prices and 24h % change - clicking changes chart market, 4) Quick Trade panel with market/amount/buy-sell/mock mode that executes trades. All data comes from live Bitvavo public API (no auth needed). Mock trades are stored in /app/backend/data/wallet/trade_history/user-001.json.
